messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync  audience is platform + infra. Proposed webinar: 'Inference playbook: benchmarks that map to buyer action'. Can we lock topic and move to abstracts + rehearsals?
Arun (Growth): Yes. We should call out one concrete outcome in promos: 'save X% per 1k tokens' (we'll use ranges).
Sam (Content): I'll draft two abstracts: short (for landing) + long (speaker notes). Will post in an hour.
Elena (Solutions): I can demo a small live compare (quantized vs fp16) but will also prepare precomputed screenshots and a fallback.
Maya (Marketing): Rehearsal availability: Tue 10am PT tech check, Thu 9am PT dress. Who's in?
Sam (Content): Both ok.
Arun (Growth): Tue works. Thu I'll join final 20min.
Elena (Solutions): In. I'll add the test endpoint and a curl sample to Drive.
EventBot: Calendar created: Tech check Tue 2024-04-16 10:00 PT, Dress Thu 2024-04-18 09:00 PT. Links sent.
Maya (Marketing): Run-of-show (first draft):
00:00-00:30 intro (Maya)
00:30-03:00 buyer pain + why cost matters (Arun)
03:00-10:00 benchmark design + methodology (Sam + Elena)
10:00-18:00 live compare + fallback (Elena)
18:00-20:00 TL;DR + CTA (Maya)
20:00-30:00 Q&A
30:00-60:00 internal debrief / follow-ups
Elena (Solutions): For demos: live call capped at 60s, then switch to precomputed. I'll host fallback at CDN if needed.
Arun (Growth): Registration fields request: Role, Main inference challenge, Budget band (optional) so we can route leads.
Sam (Content): Draft 30s landing blurb: "Join Redwood Inference for a concise playbook on inference cost vs latency. Real benchmarks, practical knobs, and a checklist for production-ready serving." Feedback?
Maya (Marketing): Nice. Add invite line: "For platform, infra, and product teams."
Sam (Content): Added. Uploaded copy to Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake-link-copyv2
Maya (Marketing): Action list: Sam: finalize abstracts + slide TL;DR; Elena: test endpoint + screenshots; Arun: promo calendar + routing; Maya: send invites + recording ops. Mark done here when complete.
Elena (Solutions): Test endpoint ready and curl snippet in Drive.
Arun (Growth): Promo calendar scheduled. Will queue ad creatives once abstracts land.
Sam (Content): Abstracts + speaker bullets uploaded (v1).
Maya (Marketing): Great. I'll circulate deck link for comments tomorrow. Closing thread unless blockers come up :rocket:
